prompt: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x) = ax + b$, where $a$ and $b$ are constants. If $f(0) = -4$ and $f(5) = 11$, what is the value of $a$?
hint: $f(0)$ hands you $b$ immediately — the $ax$ term vanishes.

hints.text: $f(0)$ hands you $b$ immediately — the $ax$ term vanishes.

learningObjective: Recover the parameters of a linear function from two function values.

alternativeExplanations.title: Read it as slope between two points
steps: The constant $a$ in $ax + b$ *is* the slope: $\dfrac{11 - (-4)}{5 - 0} = \dfrac{15}{5} = 3$.
Seeing function values as coordinates turns most of these questions into a one-line slope computation.
